messages.subject: Ionela | Director-Level Energy, Government Relations & ESG Executive | International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Stancu,

I am reaching out regarding senior leadership opportunities at Hidroelectrica where government relations, sustainability, external affairs, strategic partnerships and major-project stakeholder management intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major international mining operation undergoing substantial investment and renewable-energy expansion.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. This combination gives me a strong fit for Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country-facing leadership.

Hidroelectrica's position in renewable power and strategic infrastructure makes the company especially relevant to my background. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation.

I have attached a Hidroelectrica-tailored executive CV for consideration for current or future leadership mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
